title: Mastery of Endurance
summary: Survive a twenty-minute assault with coordinated control and sustained healing.
overview: Survive a twenty-minute assault with coordinated control and sustained healing.

sections.title: Encounter strategy
bullets: Prepare for a survival fight rather than a quick boss burn.
Collect each new wave and use crowd control to keep the number of active attackers manageable.
Conserve mana and rotate defensive abilities so the raid can survive the full twenty minutes.

notes: Reviewed quest source; behavior, balance, spawns and completion have not been verified in a live instance.
This document applies to instance version 2.
